Triage: lands in `domain:spec` (lint) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:build · Bug · Broken at run time (six classes of regex pattern error that QuickJS rejects still take the compile check's warning arm, so the action ships and then fails when it runs) · builders writing regex in action bodies, rare · three repro steps on the card → p2. 2026-11-20T05:15Z · **This card now carries a fold group.** Shared mechanism: the hook/job/action js-body compile check: refusal arms, coded run-time failures and the review follow-ups of PR #35713. The cards below, unclaimed and unstarted, are closed into this one so a single claimant fixes them in one PR. Each row's source card keeps its full body; this card closes when every row below and its own ask are done. Grade stays the highest of the group.

- [ ] #35715 (p3) runtime: a hook or job body that fails to compile reports the generic `<kind> 'NAME' threw: SyntaxError …` sentence, not the coded compile-failure an action body gets (found on #34987) — read #35715 for its full detail and acceptance.
- [ ] #35720 (p3) hook/job compile check follow-ups from the contract review of PR #35713: suppressWarnings note, "no runtime job door" scope, lowered-hook hint, a QuickJS (ctx) pin, stale AsyncFunction wording — read #35720 for its full detail and acceptance.
